title: Several conditions
setup:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("players.csv")
explanation: To combine conditions, use & for AND (both must be true) and | for OR (either one is enough). Each condition must sit in its own round brackets: df[(cond1) & (cond2)]. Forgetting the brackets is the most common mistake here. To check against a list of values, use isin(): df[df["country"].isin(["Japan", "UK"])] keeps players from either country. That's a shortcut for several | conditions.

lines.explain: AND: both conditions must be true.
Condition 2, in its own brackets. Result: NoScopeNate and xXDragonXx.

tasks.prompt: Predict first: how many rows will this show?
hints: Both must be true: from Japan AND more than 50 hours.
The two Japan players have 88 and 12 hours.

solution_lines.explain: Both Japan players pass the first check, but only luna_plays (88 hours) passes the second. mochi has just 12. So 1 row.

tasks.prompt: Fill in the blank to show players from Japan OR Brazil.
hints: Either country is fine, so you need OR, not AND.

solution_lines.explain: OR: keep a row if either condition is true. That's luna_plays, mochi and speedy_g.

tasks.prompt: Show players from the USA with fewer than 400 hours played.
hints: Two conditions that must both be true: use &, with each condition in brackets.

solution_lines.explain: From the USA AND under 400 hours: just ShadowFox.

tasks.prompt: Show players from Japan, Mexico or the Philippines. Use isin().
hints: isin() takes a list, inside its round brackets.

solution_lines.explain: True for any row whose country is in the list: 4 players.

tasks.prompt: Predict first: what happens when you run this? (Look at the brackets.)
hints: Each condition needs its own round brackets when you use &.
Without brackets, Python tries to do the & part first and gets confused.

solution_lines.explain: Python runs & before == and >, so it tries "USA" & df["hours_played"], which makes no sense, and you get an error. Fix: put each condition in its own brackets.

recap: You just learned to combine conditions with & (AND) and | (OR), each wrapped in brackets, and to match a list of values with isin().
